col_1: Walt Disney World + Universal Orlando, including Disney water parks and Universal Volcano Bay. Activity Types: Attraction, Entertainment, Dining, Special Event.
Required Admission / Ticket = what you MUST hold to enter the park/activity. Optional Fast Access / Pass = Lightning Lane / Universal Express, which do NOT replace park admission.
Intensity comes ONLY from DisneyGirlBlog. If an exact current Attraction/Entertainment item has no explicit rating there, use Unknown. Dining and Special Events = N/A.
Corrected explicit DisneyGirlBlog ratings that were previously left Unknown, including Tomorrowland Speedway = 1/4 (קליל), plus additional Disney and Universal items.

Special Events now also have Event Season, Start Date, End Date, Separate Event Ticket Required?, Standard Day Ticket Sufficient?, and Event Access Notes. Exact individual event nights remain a future dynamic-data layer.
Not included at this stage, by design.
Choose Resort → Park → Activity Type → Activity. The Park dropdown depends on Resort; Activity depends on Park + Activity Type.
Official Disney/Universal = current existence, naming, admission/access, dining, events and status. DisneyGirlBlog = intensity ONLY.
Hours, closures, ticket products, Lightning Lane/Express participation and exact event dates can change. Re-check official sources before purchase and on the visit day.
Disney theme-park Attractions/Entertainment are now explicitly classified as Multi Pass, Single Pass, or None. Water parks and non-Disney content use N/A.

Single Pass is a separate paid Lightning Lane product and is NOT included in Multi Pass. Current Single Pass rides: Seven Dwarfs + TRON (Magic Kingdom), Guardians (EPCOT), Rise of the Resistance (Hollywood Studios), Flight of Passage (Animal Kingdom).
Premier Pass Included? = Yes only for current Disney experiences that have Lightning Lane access; No for Disney experiences with no Lightning Lane; N/A where the field does not apply.
Multi Pass and Single Pass are separate paid products. A Single Pass attraction is NOT included in Multi Pass and requires a separate paid Single Pass purchase for Lightning Lane access.
Yes = part of the paid Multi Pass product. No = not part of Multi Pass. N/A = Lightning Lane does not apply.
Yes = Lightning Lane access requires a separate Single Pass purchase. No = it is either included in Multi Pass or Lightning Lane is not offered.
Single Pass = Yes, separately priced by attraction/date. Multi Pass = no separate per-attraction charge beyond the Multi Pass purchase.
